step.prompt: Aisha saves €25 every week into a separate savings account with no interest. How much does she accumulate in two full years (104 weeks)?
What is the key principle behind the 'Pay yourself first' budgeting method?
options: Automatically routing a set savings sum on payday before spending starts
Treating yourself to discretionary luxury items right after payday
Transferring whatever money happens to remain at the end of the month
Paying entertainment subscriptions before paying household bills
step.explanation: Paying yourself first means automating savings as soon as income arrives, ensuring consistent savings before spending begins.

step.prompt: Why is consistently saving modest amounts (e.g. €5 a day) financially impactful over time?
options: Small habitual savings accumulate into significant sums and build resilience
Commercial banks pay triple interest exclusively on daily micro-deposits
Micro-savings accounts are legally exempt from national retail price inflation
Daily deposits guarantee superior performance over equity market indices
step.explanation: Even modest daily amounts accumulate into thousands of euros over years, providing an emergency cushion and investing capital.
